global:review and project:review coexist in listing and model catalog.
Within-scope duplicate validated names fail; traversal order never selects a winner.

Real YAML parsing supports quoted/block strings, comments, Unicode, BOM, LF/CRLF and delimiter lines.
Invalid required fields, duplicate/non-string keys, tags, plain merge keys, anchors/aliases, multiple documents and invalid UTF-8 frontmatter reject with sanitized diagnostics.

limitations: Standard YAML tags such as !!str also reject; this is a documented nonblocking compatibility limitation.

assertions: Valid optional/unknown JSON-compatible fields are retained as data.
Unsupported behavioral metadata warns without tools, activation changes or hiding global entries.

Metadata discovery does not parse, retain or send unselected bodies and accepts large/non-UTF-8 body bytes after valid frontmatter.
An unselected file can be removed after discovery without affecting catalog-only preparation.
Selected instructions must be regular UTF-8, nonblank and within existing prompt bounds.
Buffered read-ahead is possible; no zero physical body-byte read claim is made.
Malformed individual skills are excluded with visible diagnostics while valid unrelated entries remain.
Unreadable traversal directories and ambiguous identities fail rather than silently return partial discovery.
Ordinary diagnostics/Debug omit YAML/body contents and canonical private paths and filter/escape terminal controls.
Caller-selected root links may canonicalize deliberately; descendant links do not extend the selected boundary.
Unsafe manifests, links, directories and FIFOs are not read as skills/instructions; device-target links reject without creating a device node.
Containment and regular-file checks plus Unix no-follow/nonblocking final opens are present.
limitations: Linux execution only; Windows/macOS not run.
No hostile-filesystem sandbox, hardlink isolation or elimination of ancestor/TOCTOU races.
